item.title: The Archipelago and the Umbrella: Harmonizing French and NATO Nuclear Deterrence
item.description: France’s new “forward deterrence” concept can strengthen European security, but only if Paris coordinates carefully with NATO allies to avoid fragmented signaling, friction over basing, and political anxieties about the U.S. nuclear umbrella.

item.title: Winning the Salvo Competition: How to Rebuild the Air and Missile Defense Industrial Base
item.description: Recent wars show that the side able to replenish interceptors fastest will shape the military balance. The United States and Europe should turn surge spending into durable capacity through predictable demand, shared investment, and coordinated production.

item.title: How Taiwan’s Development Work in the Caribbean Can Counteract Chinese Influence
item.description: Taiwan's development assistance in the Caribbean can reinforce democratic partnerships, complement existing development initiatives, and provide regional partners with alternatives to expanding Chinese influence.

item.description: This edition of Trendlines covers August 2026.

item.title: How Washington Can Credibly Counter China in the Pacific
item.description: In Foreign Policy, Charles Edel and Kathryn Paik argue the U.S. needs a comprehensive, consistent, and fully resourced Pacific strategy to counter China.

item.title: Takaichi’s Approval Shield: Prospects for Her Second Year in Office
item.description: Takaichi’s public support remains her strongest political asset, but her second year will test whether she can use that capital to keep party and coalition actors aligned while moving her domestic agenda toward implementation and sustaining Japan’s commitments abroad.

item.title: Missed Opportunity: Critical Minerals and the U.S.-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
item.description: Whether the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership fulfills its early promise will depend on whether Washington and Hanoi can move past current frictions and convert shared strategic interests into concrete, resilient cooperation.
